subject.title: feat: add workspace file management for agents

question: Should OpenClaw core accept a full `agents.workspace.*` filesystem read/write/delete Gateway API now, and what namespace, scopes, bounds, audit behavior, and destructive-operation UX must it use?
rationale: This PR creates a new core filesystem authority boundary; automation can identify stale contracts and safety blockers, but maintainers need to decide the permanent API and security policy before merge.

options.title: Sponsor a rebased core API
options.body: Accept the feature direction only after the branch moves to the current protocol package and method descriptors, adds traversal/size bounds, and receives explicit security/API approval.

options.title: Narrow the first slice
options.body: Limit this PR or a replacement to a smaller read-only or allowlisted workspace browser while leaving destructive operations for a later approved design.

options.title: Keep design in the canonical issue
options.body: Pause this branch and continue API/security discussion in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/61368 until a maintainer-owned implementation shape is clear.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a rebased core API
recommendation.body: Accept the feature direction only after the branch moves to the current protocol package and method descriptors, adds traversal/size bounds, and receives explicit security/API approval.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway/protocol commits make steipete the best available routing owner for the current registry and API-shape decision.
